name: Catalyst 9000 Switch Automated Onboarding
description: Automates claiming Catalyst 9200/9300/9500 switches into Meraki Dashboard, configuring IOS-XE TLS/telemetry prerequisites, and validating online connectivity.

network_id.label: Meraki Network ID
network_id.description: Target Network ID to place the switch (e.g. L_12345678)

switch_serial.label: Catalyst Serial Number
switch_serial.description: Hardware serial number printed on switch (e.g. FOC2412XXXX)

switch_management_ip.label: Switch Management IP
switch_management_ip.description: Reachable IPv4 address for SSH/RESTCONF configuration

webex_webhook_url.label: Webex Notification Webhook (Optional)
webex_webhook_url.description: Webex Space Webhook URL for NetOps onboarding status alerts

workflow_steps.name: Push Cloud Telemetry & TLS Config to Switch CLI

payload.markdown:
### ✅ Catalyst Switch Onboarding Completed
- **Serial:** `{{input.switch_serial}}`
- **Switch IP:** `{{input.switch_management_ip}}`
- **Network ID:** `{{input.network_id}}`
- **Status:** Cloud Tunnel Active (Online)
